qs.q:
Read the messages. What is the main idea of each message?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.

What does Layla want Harvey to keep quiet about?

Email: "You don’t have to keep quiet about the party on Saturday but you mustn’t tell him that Derek and I are dating."

What does Matthew think about the test?

Email: "I had a test at school today. Everyone said it was easy, but I couldn’t do it... the teacher gave me a bad mark. That’s unfair."

How often does Matilda go to the shops?

Email: "I always forget something, so I have to go to the shops just about every other day. I should make a list so I need to go only once a week."

Why isn’t Bethany going to the party?

Email: "My parents won’t let me. They say my school grades aren’t good enough and I have to stay at home and study."

When must Sienna and Alice give in their project work?

Email: "I must have it on Wednesday so I can produce a finished product on Thursday. We have to hand it in on Friday so Mr Davies can look at it during the weekend."

What is Nathan Hunt’s occupation?

"There was a big demand for people to teach English and I got a job as a teacher in Gap."

What did Nathan Hunt study at university?

"But studying architecture gave me discipline. It brought structure to my painting."

Where is Nathan Hunt from?

"People often say ‘Why do you, a Londoner, want to live here?’"

What is Nathan Hunt’s favourite painting?

"But this painting, ‘Shepherdess’, is not for sale. I will always have it with me in my studio."

What is Nathan Hunt’s most famous painting?

"If you travel on the London Underground, you have probably seen a poster of ‘Moonlight’, the painting, which has brought the artist, Nathan Hunt, to the international scene."

Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. Mr Cullen worked as a sales manager. He wanted to make changes, but the owners ignored him ___.
17. It had 6,000 square feet ___.
18. It had a very successful slogan, ___.
19. Since it had a parking lot, ___.
20. After Mr Cullen’s death, his wife ran the business ___.
rights: A — and later his children took over.
B — so he decided to open his own shop.
C — so they closed the shop.
D — it attracted customers from far away.
E — and was situated next to a very busy shopping district.
F — which meant the place was full of goods at low prices.
